  ()
  :match (and (has ?who ?k ?thing) (gave ?who ?m ?to))

  together-is-the-sum
  ()
  :match (and (has ?who ?k ?thing) (gave ?who ?m ?to) (sum-of ?k ?m ?s))

  :why "{?k} and {?m} make {?s}, so {?who} and {?to} have {?s} together")
